name: Aku'mai
summary: Aku'mai is a monstrous, three-headed hydra dwelling in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand. A servant of an Old God, it rose from the waters when that Old God's corruption tainted the temple's sacred Moon Well. The Twilight's Hammer cult has gathered in the Deeps and sacrifices innocents to it for power.

sections.title: The Scourge of Zoram Strand
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps was once a great temple of Elune, until the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted its sacred Moon Well. Aku'mai, a gargantuan hydra and servant of the Old God, rose from the waters. Rather than an ordinary denizen of the tides, Aku'mai is a living blight upon the Zoram Strand that has taken up residence in the submerged ruins of the night elves' fallen temple, poisoning the waters with its malice.

sections.title: Servant of the Primordial Darkness
sections.body: Aku'mai's foul presence eventually drew the Twilight's Hammer deep into the subterranean caverns. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris and allied with the naga, the cultists occupy the drowned temple and sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power.

aliases: what kind of monster is akumai
faq.answer: Aku'mai is an ancient, three-headed hydra steeped in dark power. A servant of an Old God, it rose from the tainted waters of Blackfathom Deeps and now lairs in the temple's submerged halls.
Aku'mai resides in the deepest submerged grottos of Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined temple complex dedicated to Elune located along the coast of the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer feeding Aku'mai?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer reveres Aku'mai as a servant of the Old Gods they worship. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists sacrifice innocents to the beast in exchange for dark power.

Beyond its immense physical size and multiple snapping heads, Aku'mai carries the dark favor of the Old Gods. In battle it flies into frenzied rages and engulfs those who draw near in clouds of poison.
No. Aku'mai is not an Old God, but a primordial hydra that serves one. Its evil presence is enough to draw the Twilight's Hammer to worship around it.

faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the deeps to slay it?
faq.answer: Left unchecked, Aku'mai's savagery and the cult's devotion threaten to unleash a calamitous evil across Ashenvale and Kalimdor. Both Alliance and Horde authorities seek to put an end to the Twilight's Hammer and slay the horror lurking at the heart of the temple.

angles.text: Aku'mai has defiled the deepest sanctorum of a ruined temple once consecrated to the moon-goddess Elune, turning a holy site into a lair of corruption.
The vile presence of Aku'mai and the Twilight's Hammer represents the corruption of the Old Gods set against the teachings of the Holy Light and Elune.
Aku'mai's unnatural corruption warps the coastal waters of Ashenvale, demanding cleansing to restore natural balance.
